title: Modeling Dependency-Propagated Ecosystem Impact of Changes in Maintenance Activities: Evaluating Support Strategies in the PyPI Network
abstract: arXiv:2605.06164v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Background: Open source software ecosystems exhibit dense dependency networks in which maintenance degradation of structurally central packages can propagate widely. Despite increasing attention to open source sustainability, existing support mechanisms lack an explicit, dependencyaware notion of ecosystem-level impact to guide support decisions. Aims: In this paper, we introduce a dependency-aware model of ecosystem impact that captures how changes in maintenance activities propagate through the Python Package Index (PyPI) ecosystem and affect its overall state. Based on this model, we prioritize packages for ecosystem support using our dependency-propagated notion of ecosystem impact. translated_title: 建模维护活动变化对依赖传播的生态系统影响：评估PyPI网络中的支持策略
translated_abstract: 背景：开源软件生态系统表现出密集的依赖网络，其中结构上核心的包维护退化可能广泛传播。尽管对开源可持续性的关注日益增加，现有支持机制缺乏明确的、依赖感知的生态系统级影响概念来指导支持决策。目的：在本文中，我们引入了一种依赖感知的生态系统影响模型，该模型捕捉维护活动变化如何通过Python包索引（PyPI）生态系统传播并影响其整体状态。基于此模型，我们使用依赖传播的生态系统影响概念优先为生态系统支持选择包。方法：将此框架应用于包含718,750个PyPI包和超过200万个依赖的快照，我们将基于影响的策略与现有支持机制（Tidelift、Ecosyste$.$ms和GitHub Sponsors）以及PageRank进行比较。
tldr: 本文提出了一种依赖感知的生态系统影响模型，通过PyPI网络传播维护活动变化，并据此优化支持策略，以更有效地指导开源软件生态系统的维护决策。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a dependency-aware ecosystem impact model that propagates maintenance activity changes through the PyPI network, thereby optimizing support strategies for more effective maintenance decisions in open-source ecosystems.
